prompts.display_text: Pin a country where ground was broken for a new temple in 2022.
prompts.text_original: Pin a country where ground was broken for a new temple in 2022.
prompts.citation: ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org chronology and milestones, read 27 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: In 2022 ground was broken for 16 temples in 7 countries or territories, 10 of them in the United States. Sierra Leone's temple in Freetown broke ground on 19 March 2022.

answers.name: United States of America
answers.fact: Grand Junction Colorado (16 April 2022); Lindon Utah (23 April 2022); Farmington New Mexico (30 April 2022); and 7 more.

answers.name: Mexico
answers.fact: Torreón Mexico (10 December 2022).

answers.name: Argentina
answers.fact: Bahía Blanca Argentina (9 April 2022).

answers.name: Guatemala
answers.fact: Miraflores Guatemala City Guatemala (3 December 2022).

answers.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
answers.fact: Lubumbashi Democratic Republic of the Congo (20 August 2022).

answers.name: Nicaragua
answers.fact: Managua Nicaragua (26 November 2022).

answers.name: Sierra Leone
answers.fact: Freetown Sierra Leone (19 March 2022).

prompts.display_text: Pin a country holding a place in the story of Sennacherib's invasion of Judah, 2 Kings 18:13-19:37
prompts.text_original: A present-day country holding a place named in the story of Sennacherib's invasion of Judah in 2 Kings 18:13-19:37: Lachish, Samaria, the conquered cities his envoys boasted of (Hamath, Arpad, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph), Egypt and Tirhakah king of the Nile land of Cush, Nineveh, and the land of Armenia where his killers fled
prompts.note: Cush lay mostly in Sudan, reaching into southern Egypt; modern Ethiopia is not counted. Samaria is in the West Bank.
prompts.summary: In Hezekiah's fourteenth year Sennacherib of Assyria took Judah's fenced cities and besieged Lachish. His officer Rabshakeh mocked trust in Egypt and listed the gods of conquered cities. Hezekiah prayed, Isaiah prophesied, and the angel of the Lord smote the Assyrian camp; Sennacherib returned to Nineveh, where his sons slew him (2 Kgs 18-19).

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Sennacherib took the fenced cities of Judah and camped at Lachish, then sent his army against Jerusalem (2 Kgs 18:13-17).

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: Rabshakeh mocked Judah's trust in Egypt, that bruised reed (2 Kgs 18:21).

answers.name: Iraq
answers.fact: After the angel smote the camp, Sennacherib went home and dwelt at Nineveh (2 Kgs 19:35-36).

answers.name: Syria
answers.fact: His envoys asked where the gods of Hamath and Arpad were, and named Gozan and Rezeph among lands Assyria destroyed (2 Kgs 18:34; 19:12).

answers.name: Lebanon
answers.fact: Sennacherib boasted he had come up with his chariots to the sides of Lebanon to cut its cedars (2 Kgs 19:23).

answers.name: Palestine
answers.fact: They also asked whether any god had delivered Samaria (2 Kgs 18:34).

answers.name: Turkey
answers.fact: Haran is among the places they boasted of destroying (2 Kgs 19:12); Bible Dictionary Haran places it near the source of the Euphrates.

answers.name: Armenia
answers.fact: His sons Adrammelech and Sharezer smote him and escaped into the land of Armenia (2 Kgs 19:37); Bible Dictionary Ararat: the district the Assyrians called Urartu, now called Armenia.

answers.name: Sudan
answers.fact: Tirhakah king of Ethiopia marched out to fight him (2 Kgs 19:9); Bible Ethiopia was the Nile land south of Egypt.

prompts.display_text: Pin a South American country President Hinckley visited on his November 1996 or August 1997 tours
prompts.text_original: President Gordon B. Hinckley made two sweeping South American tours: six countries in November 1996 and four more in August 1997, where his addresses in Paraguay and Ecuador were believed to be the first by a Church President. A country he visited on either tour.
prompts.citation: Ensign, Feb. 1997 and Nov. 1997, News of the Church
prompts.note: Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana were not visited on either tour.
prompts.summary: In November 1996 President Gordon B. Hinckley spoke to more than 218,000 Saints in Colombia, Peru, Bolivia, Chile, Argentina and Brazil. In August 1997 he returned for Uruguay, Paraguay, Ecuador and Venezuela; his talks in Paraguay and Ecuador were believed to be the first by a Church President there.

answers.name: Argentina
answers.fact: November 1996: he addressed about 50,000 members in Buenos Aires.

answers.name: Brazil
answers.fact: November 1996: he spoke in Porto Alegre, Sao Paulo, Recife and Manaus, and broke ground for the Recife temple.

answers.name: Chile
answers.fact: November 1996: he spoke to about 48,000 members in two stadium sessions in Santiago.

answers.name: Peru
answers.fact: November 1996: he held two conferences in Lima attended by about 28,000 members.

answers.name: Bolivia
answers.fact: November 1996: he broke ground for a temple in Cochabamba in heavy rain.

answers.name: Colombia
answers.fact: November 1996: he toured the Bogota temple site and addressed about 7,000 members.

answers.name: Ecuador
answers.fact: August 11-12, 1997: he toured the Guayaquil temple site and addressed members in Guayaquil and Quito.

answers.name: Venezuela
answers.fact: August 13, 1997: he spoke to missionaries in Caracas and to 10,000 members in Valencia.

answers.name: Paraguay
answers.fact: August 10, 1997: he spoke to about 7,000 members in a stadium in Asuncion.

answers.name: Uruguay
answers.fact: August 9, 1997: he addressed more than 11,000 members at a regional conference in Montevideo.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country where an angel, vision or dream came on land to someone living in New Testament times (not the Transfiguration)
prompts.text_original: A present-day country holding a place on land where an angel appeared, or the Lord gave a vision or dream, to someone living in New Testament times, in the Gospels, Acts or Revelation (not the Transfiguration)
prompts.note: Bethlehem is in the West Bank (Palestine); Israel also counts.
prompts.summary: Heavenly messengers appear all through the New Testament. Gabriel came to Zacharias and Mary, angels sang to shepherds near Bethlehem, and an angel guided Joseph in Egypt. Saul met the Lord near Damascus, Paul saw the man of Macedonia at Troas, the Lord comforted him at Corinth, and John saw his Revelation on Patmos.

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Gabriel came to Zacharias in the temple and to Mary in Nazareth; Peter saw a vision at Joppa (Luke 1:11, 26; Acts 10:9-17).

answers.name: Palestine
answers.fact: An angel appeared to shepherds near Bethlehem, where the wise men were also warned in a dream (Luke 2:8-9; Matthew 2:12).

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: An angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt after Herod died (Matthew 2:19).

answers.name: Syria
answers.fact: Saul saw a light near Damascus, and Ananias saw the Lord in a vision there (Acts 9:3-12).

answers.name: Greece
answers.fact: The Lord spoke to Paul in a vision at Corinth, and John received the Revelation on Patmos (Acts 18:9; Revelation 1:9-10).

answers.name: Turkey
answers.fact: At Troas Paul saw a vision of a man of Macedonia pleading for help (Acts 16:8-9).

prompts.display_text: Pin a former Soviet republic that an Apostle opened to missionaries with a prayer, 1990-1993.
prompts.text_original: As the Soviet Union opened and then broke apart, Apostles dedicated or rededicated several of its former republics for the preaching of the gospel. A former Soviet republic, in its present-day borders, that an Apostle dedicated or rededicated between 1990 and 1993.
prompts.citation: Global Histories chronologies (Estonia, Russia, Armenia, Ukraine, Latvia, Lithuania, Belarus); Church News 1993
prompts.note: Georgia (1999), Moldova (2001), Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan (2003) were dedicated later, so they do not count.
prompts.summary: Between 1990 and 1993, as the Soviet Union opened and then dissolved, five Apostles dedicated or rededicated seven of its former republics. Elder Russell M. Nelson prayed over Estonia and Russia in April 1990 and Belarus in 1993; Elders Oaks, Packer, Faust and Ballard dedicated Armenia, Ukraine, Latvia and Lithuania.

answers.name: Russia
answers.fact: Elder Russell M. Nelson rededicated Russia in Leningrad's Summer Garden, April 26, 1990.

answers.name: Ukraine
answers.fact: Elder Boyd K. Packer dedicated Ukraine in Kyiv, September 12, 1991.

answers.name: Estonia
answers.fact: Elder Russell M. Nelson dedicated Estonia near Tallinn, April 25, 1990.

answers.name: Armenia
answers.fact: Elder Dallin H. Oaks offered the prayer dedicating Armenia in Yerevan, June 24, 1991.

answers.name: Lithuania
answers.fact: Elder M. Russell Ballard dedicated Lithuania in Vilnius, February 20, 1993.

answers.name: Latvia
answers.fact: Elder James E. Faust dedicated Latvia at Jurmala, March 17, 1993.

answers.name: Belarus
answers.fact: Elder Russell M. Nelson dedicated Belarus in Yanka Kupala Park, Minsk, May 11, 1993.
